# Actual Alpha81 mail TLS producer bytes

Generated by running `encodeMailTLSSyncJournal` in the actual Alpha81 Agent
source at `45dfc265bfd7997e9a0e0d39b0ebf60a57f58c00`, extracted by git archive
into a private ext4 test directory. The temporary export test called the real
`CanonicalMailTLSSync` and journal producer; no reimplementation generated JSON.

Inputs: request ID 32 lowercase `a`, managed root `/etc/ssl/celikpanel`, mail host
`mail.host.example.test`. Empty fixture has no SNI. SNI fixture supplies names
`mail.example.test`, `example.test` and the same immutable version `sha256-`
followed by 64 lowercase `b` beneath `example.test`, with fullchain.pem/privkey.pem.
The producer canonicalizes name order and computes the qualifier. Neither file
has a trailing newline. These are public syntax fixtures, not native host proof.
